title: ALMA CO observations of a giant molecular cloud in M 33: Evidence for high-mass star formation triggered by cloud-cloud collisions
question: Whether high-mass star formation in giant molecular cloud 37 (M33GMC 37) in M33 is triggered by cloud-cloud collisions

data.sensitivity: ~0.15 K at 1 km s^-1 (line) and 0.017 mJy beam^-1 (continuum)

evidence.quote: The typical spatial resolution is $\sim2$ pc at the distance of M33 ($817 \pm 59$ kpc, (cite: 2001ApJ...553...47F)).
To estimate the missing flux density, we used the $^{12}$CO($J$ = 2–1) dataset obtained with the IRAM 30-m radio telescope ((cite: 2010A&A...522A...3G; 2014A&A...567A.118D)).

what.value: CO-to-H2 conversion factor X_CO = 4.0 x 10^20 (K km s^-1)^-1 cm^-2

evidence.quote: Following the previous study by (cite: 2012A&A...542A.108G), we used $X = 4.0 \times 10^{20}$ (K km s$^{-1}$)$^{-1}$ cm$^{-2}$.

We also derived a typical intensity ratio of $^{12}$CO($J$ = 2–1) / $^{12}$CO($J$ = 1–0) $\sim0.7$ toward M33GMC 37 through the comparison with an archival $^{12}$CO($J$ = 1–0) cube data obtained with the Nobeyama Radio Observatory 45-m telescope ((cite: 2011PASJ...63.1171T)).

what.value: 24 μm luminosity (~1.7 x 10^38 erg s^-1) and Hα luminosity (~4.6 x 10^37 erg s^-1)

recipe.method: Compare integrated intensities of ALMA and IRAM 30-m 12CO(J=2-1) data after smoothing to 12'' FWHM resolution
assumptions: IRAM 30-m forward efficiency = 0.92, main beam efficiency = 0.56

recipe.goal: Create moment maps, velocity channel maps, and position-velocity diagrams, and identify millimeter continuum sources
recipe.method: Generate moment 0, 1, and 2 maps, velocity channel maps, and R.A.-integrated PV diagrams of CO lines; detect 1.3 mm continuum sources at >= 5 sigma and compute source sizes from 5 sigma contour area
key_parameters: 5 sigma detection threshold for 1.3 mm continuum sources; size defined as (S / pi)^0.5 * 2
Blue cloud velocity range: V_LSR = -143.0 to -134.0 km s^-1; Red cloud velocity range: V_LSR = -133.0 to -127.0 km s^-1
PV diagram R.A. integration range: 01h33m35.243s to 01h33m35.341s

recipe.goal: Derive H2 column densities and molecular cloud masses
recipe.method: Convert 12CO(J=2-1) integrated intensity to 12CO(J=1-0) using measured line ratio, apply X_CO factor to get N(H2), and sum over pixels using Equations (1) and (2)

recipe.goal: Identify embedded high-mass stars and estimate their spectral types
recipe.method: Align archival HST WFPC2/WFC3 images using Gaia DR2, count bright stars in KPNO Hα contours, and derive spectral types from Spitzer 24 μm luminosity (via TIR luminosity Eq. 3) and KPNO Hα luminosity (via Lyman continuum Eq. 4)
assumptions: Ten high-mass stars having the same spectral types

recipe.goal: Test whether stellar wind feedback can explain the cloud velocity separation
recipe.method: Compare estimated total stellar wind momentum of ten O-type stars with the total expanding momentum of the two molecular clouds
key_parameters: Expanding velocity ~ 3 km s^-1 (half the velocity separation of the two clouds)
assumptions: 10 O-type stars, mass loss rate ~ 10^-6 M_sun yr^-1, wind duration ~ 10^6 yr, wind velocity ~ 2000 km s^-1

recipe.goal: Quantify complementary spatial distribution and estimate cloud-cloud collision timescale
recipe.method: Calculate spatial correlation coefficient between intensity distributions of red and blue clouds as a function of R.A. and Dec. displacement, find local minimum, and divide deprojected displacement by deprojected velocity difference
key_parameters: Shift of 15 pix in R.A. and -12 pix in Dec. (~6.2 pc southeast)
assumptions: Collision angle θ = 45 degrees relative to line of sight
